create_PerceptionLMImageProcessor: create a PerceptionLMImageProcessor instance with custom tile_size, max_num_tiles, and vision_input_type settings
run_preprocess_images: run the preprocess method on a batch of images to produce tiled, normalized pixel values for PerceptionLM
resize_image_tiles: resize an image into tiles using the custom resize method with configurable tile_size and max_num_tiles
fit_image_to_canvas: fit an image to the best tile canvas arrangement by evaluating supported aspect ratios and tile grids
split_image_into_tiles: split a resized torch tensor image into a grid of ncw by nch tiles for multi-scale processing
